display.name: CPU Busy
display.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together

display.name: Sys Load (5m avg)
display.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together (5 min average)

display.name: Uptime
display.description: System uptime

display.name: Sys Load (15m avg)
display.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together (15 min average)

display.name: RAM Used
display.description: Estimated non-reclaimable RAM. Free, cached, inactive, and ZFS ARC memory above its minimum are considered available. Falls back to excluding only free, cached, and inactive memory when ARC metrics are unavailable.

display.name: SWAP Used
display.description: Percentage of swap space currently used by the system

display.name: Root Pool Used
display.description: Allocated percentage of the ZFS pool backing /. Includes all datasets and snapshots in that pool, not just the root dataset.

display.name: CPU Cores
display.description: Total number of CPU cores

display.name: RAM Total
display.description: Total RAM

display.name: SWAP Total
display.description: Total SWAP

display.name: Root Pool Total
display.description: Capacity reported by ZFS for the pool backing /, not the root dataset's shared free-space view. Decimal byte units: 1 TB = 10^12 bytes.

display.name: CPU
display.description: CPU time usage split by state, normalized across all CPU cores

spec.seriesNameFormat: System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode
Idle - Waiting for something to happen
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode

display.name: Memory
display.description: Memory usage breakdown

spec.seriesNameFormat: Inactive - Memory not recently accessed, can be reclaimed
Active - Memory currently being used by a process
Cache - Memory being used to cache data, can be freed immediately if required
Wired - Memory in use by the Kernel
Free - Completely unused memory available for allocation

display.name: Network Traffic
display.description: Incoming and outgoing network traffic per interface

display.name: Memory Swap In / Out
display.description: Rate of swap memory bytes moved in and out per second

display.name: Network Traffic Packets
display.description: Rate of network packets transmitted and received per second

display.name: Network Traffic Drops
display.description: Rate of dropped network packets during transmission and reception per second

display.name: Network Traffic Errors
display.description: Rate of network transmission and reception errors per second

display.name: Network Traffic Multicast
display.description: Rate of multicast packets transmitted and received per second

display.name: Network Traffic No Proto
display.description: Rate of network packets received without a recognized protocol per second

display.name: Network Traffic Collisions
display.description: Rate of packet collisions detected during transmission

display.name: Context Switches
display.description: Per-second rate of context switches

display.name: Interrupts
display.description: Per-second rate of hardware and software interrupts

display.name: System Load
display.description: System load average over 1, 5, and 15 minutes. Reflects the number of active or waiting processes

display.name: System Calls
display.description: Rate of system calls executed per second

display.name: Processes Forks / Traps
display.description: Rate of process forks and processor traps handled per second

display.name: System Time Variation
display.description: Rate of change in system-reported time per second

display.name: Node Exporter Scrape Time
display.description: Duration of each individual collector executed during a Node Exporter scrape

display.name: Node Exporter Scrape
display.description: Shows whether each Node Exporter collector scraped successfully (1 = success, 0 = failure), and whether the textfile collector returned an error.

display.name: ZFS exporter
display.description: Whether VictoriaMetrics can scrape the host's ZFS exporter. Collector failures are shown separately.

display.name: ZFS pool health
display.description: Health of each pool: ONLINE, DEGRADED, FAULTED, OFFLINE, UNAVAILABLE, REMOVED or SUSPENDED.

display.name: ZFS pool fragmentation
display.description: Free-space fragmentation per pool. This is not file fragmentation or the percentage of space used.

display.name: ZFS pool access
display.description: Whether each pool was imported read-only.

display.name: ZFS pool capacity used
display.description: Allocated pool bytes divided by total pool size. Pool-level accounting includes redundancy and differs from dataset accounting.

display.name: ZFS pool allocated / free space
display.description: Pool-level allocated and free bytes. Dataset available space may be lower because of reservations, quotas and ZFS overhead.

display.name: ZFS space used by dataset
display.description: Latest bytes used by each filesystem or volume itself, excluding children, snapshots and refreservations. Avoids double-counting parent datasets.

display.name: ZFS space retained by snapshots
display.description: Latest usedbysnapshots bytes per filesystem or volume, not including child datasets. Zero means snapshots retain no additional space. Individual snapshot collection is not required.

display.name: Device read / write IOPS
display.description: FreeBSD devstat read/write transfers per second for each reported device. These are device-level statistics, not ZFS pool-level I/O; do not sum physical and virtual device layers together.

display.name: Device read / write bandwidth
display.description: FreeBSD devstat read/write bytes per second for each reported device. These are device-level statistics, not ZFS pool-level throughput.

display.name: ZFS collector status
display.description: OK = successful collection; FAILED = failure or collection deadline exceeded. The exporter can still return cached pool and dataset values when collection fails.
